articles.title: Anchorage is stepping back from Robinhood and Kraken-backed stablecoin group
articles.snippet: Anchorage Digital co-founder and CEO Nathan McCauley said there will be ‘increased neutrality’ from his firm on stablecoins.

articles.title: Corpay taps BVNK to bring stablecoin wallets to corporate payments
articles.snippet: Corpay will use stablecoin rails in its treasury operations to improve capital efficiency, reduce reliance on pre-funded accounts, and move funds across its global footprint.

articles.title: Bitcoin whipsaws on CME open as Iran tensions pressure crypto markets
articles.snippet: BTC briefly topped $82,400 before slipping below $81,000 as traders repositioned around CME futures open and geopolitical risks rattled markets.

articles.title: Bitcoin mining pools with 75% of BTC hashrate join open standard for block construction
articles.snippet: Foundry, AntPool, F2Pool, SpiderPool, and MARA Pool are among seven pools joining the Stratum V2 working group, putting nearly three-quarters of global bitcoin hashrate behind a protocol that returns block construction decisions to individual miners.

articles.title: XRP spikes 2.5%, beating bitcoin and ether, in breakout above $1.45
articles.snippet: Sharp move through resistance came with one of the biggest volume spikes in weeks, though profit-taking quickly emerged near session highs.
